# Agent Atlas

> A private, read-only seed taxonomy of agent improvement methods. English dataset version 0.2.0.

## Resources
- [Structured dataset](./atlas.json): eight papers, stable IDs, taxonomy, three questions, scoped evidence, and sources.
- [JSON Schema](./atlas.schema.json): JSON Schema 2020-12, schema version 1.0.0.
- [Readable catalog](./catalog.html): all content in HTML; no JavaScript required.
- [Agent guide](./agent-guide.html): URL parameters, DOM controls, and interpretation rules.

## Access
The Site is private. These resources require the same authorized session as the UI. For agents without that session, the owner can download and supply atlas.json. There is no separate public API or MCP server.

## Meaning
Taxonomy parent_id and paper branch_ids describe classification, not actual ancestry. Evidence statuses must be read with their notes and source_url. Tested means the specific reported experiment, not a universal proof. Mechanism is not causal validation. Unknown means unverified in this atlas. Outside means outside the core method scope.

## Navigation
Use /?view=tree&branch=evolution&paper=dgm&question=q2 or /?view=papers&q=memory. The browser supports Back/Forward. Question lenses include tested and mechanism only; excluded papers are not negative findings.
